evaluation_contract.AP: AP of raw absolute fit-standardized residual and separately EWMA residual; no claim that either ranks inverted-branch or pruning decisions exactly. No AP across incomparable native channel scales.
evaluation_contract.aggregation: MSL and SMAP separate. Pool H,M,U,FPt,N0 across channels per seed, then average metrics across seeds17,29,43. Persistence once, not three independent observations.
evaluation_contract.benchmark_kind: locked retrospective, historically exposed NASA TEST
evaluation_contract.channel_policy: 81 unique channels,27MSL54SMAP; first P-2 CSV row; expected104 original events, preserve duplicate audit
evaluation_contract.delay: first actual alarm issue time attributable to event-overlapping flags minus true onset; never buffered flag timestamp. Late post-event notifications reported separately; never silently censored.
evaluation_contract.no_positive_AP: undefined; exclude from AP macro average and report denominator. No alarms with positive truth gives Fbeta0; wholly nominal channels contribute false alarms to pooled event counts.
evaluation_contract.no_publication_SOTA_claim: published result tables separate; controlled baselines not exact original multi-output LSTM reproduction
evaluation_contract.point_adjustment: not primary; if exported, explicitly labelled optimistic legacy diagnostic, never mix with strict metrics
evaluation_contract.post_freeze_changes: any source/scientific change requires new version and documented amendment; no detector replacement based on NASA results
evaluation_contract.primary_detector: HUNDMAN_ADAPT_V1, publication-derived adaptive batch detector; no supervised threshold tuning
evaluation_contract.primary_event_scoring: overlap of retrospective flag intervals; actual issue timing is a separate mandatory operational diagnostic, not claimed realtime scoring
evaluation_contract.primary_metric: corrected event F0.5: H/(H+U)*(1-FPt/N0) as precision; R=H/(H+M); Fbeta with beta=.5
evaluation_contract.primary_model_contrast: final_gcn minus final_matched_message_removed under each detector
evaluation_contract.reference_detector: raw_q99; TRAIN final20% calibration per model/channel/seed, higher,strict greater than
secondary_metrics: detection delay and within-event notification rate
evaluation_contract.startup: No label-dependent exception. Targets after250 remain in denominators even if detector suppresses them; report original events fully outside evaluation support separately.
evaluation_contract.uncertainty: 10000 paired channel bootstrap, resample same channels for both models, retain three seeds; bootstrap seed20261005; report seed distribution and shared-context/dependence limitations
evaluation_contract.zero_N0: corrected precision undefined; do not impute success; report excluded count
